cd /workspace && timeout 600 python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, time
def run(doc, name):
    raw=json.dumps(doc).encode()
    t=time.time()
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','submission/main.py'],input=raw,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,cwd='/workspace')
    print('%-20s bytes=%d rc=%d %.2fs out=%s' % (name, len(raw), p.returncode, time.time()-t, p.stdout.decode()[:90]))

# 1) long chains: many peeling rounds
rib=[{'path': list(range(1,65)), 'count': 1000000}]
doc={'version':1,'ixps':[],'rib':rib,'priors':[],'declared':[],'order':[],
     'queries':[{'id':'a','path':list(range(1,65)),'threshold':[1,2]}]}
run(doc,'single chain64')

# 2) 625 long chains over distinct ASN ranges (sum lengths = 40000)
rib=[]
for i in range(625):
    base=i*70+1
    rib.append({'path': [base+j for j in range(64)], 'count': 1000})
doc={'version':1,'ixps':[],'rib':rib,'priors':[],'declared':[],'order':[],'queries':[]}
run(doc,'625 chains')

# 3) staggered chains to force many rounds
rib=[]
for i in range(625):
    base=i*70+1
    p=[base+j for j in range(64)]
    if i%2: p=p[::-1]
    rib.append({'path': p, 'count': 1000})
doc={'version':1,'ixps':[],'rib':rib,'priors':[],'declared':[],'order':[],'queries':[]}
run(doc,'625 chains mixed')

# 4) many IXPs
rib=[{'path':[1,99,2,99,3,99,4],'count':5} for _ in range(50)]
doc={'version':1,'ixps':[99],'rib':rib,'priors':[],'declared':[],'order':[],
     'queries':[{'id':'a','path':[1,99,2,3,4],'threshold':[1,2]}]}
run(doc,'ixp heavy')

# 5) 2000 identical records aggregate
rib=[{'path':[1,2,3],'count':1000000} for _ in range(2000)]
doc={'version':1,'ixps':[],'rib':rib,'priors':[],'declared':[],'order':[],
     'queries':[{'id':'a','path':[1,2,3],'threshold':[1,2]}]}
run(doc,'2000 identical')
EOF
